name: Felodipine

examples.title: Hypertension in Hemodialysis Patients (Aim 3)
examples.why: Stopped by data safety monitoring board

summary: A small computer program, rather than tests on real people, gave Felodipine a high risk score of 71 for liver problems and a low risk score of 27 for heart problems [M]. A search found one clinical trial testing the drug in patients with high blood pressure who were receiving treatments to filter their blood [4][5]. This study was stopped early by an independent group that watches over participant safety [5].
